column2: The dataset provides HMIS item-wise monthly reporting for sub-districts of West Siang, Arunachal Pradesh, covering {period}. It supports monitoring of health service delivery and planning by providing provisional monthly figures across HMIS reporting items. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, and updates follow a monthly reporting cycle.

This dataset compiles HMIS item-wise monthly reporting for sub-districts in West Siang, Arunachal Pradesh, covering {period}. It supports tracking service delivery and facility coverage using provisional figures. The data is published by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare and is updated on a monthly basis.

This dataset compiles HMIS item-wise monthly reports for sub-districts in West, Sikkim, covering {period}. It tracks health service delivery details across public and private facilities and across rural and urban facilities. Published by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, it supports program monitoring and administrative review with monthly updates.

This dataset provides HMIS item-wise monthly reporting for health information systems covering sub-districts in Yanam, Puducherry, for {period}. It supports monitoring service delivery across public and private facilities and assessing rural and urban availability. The data is shared monthly, with provisional figures.

Monthly Health Management Information System (HMIS) reports with item-wise reporting at the State/UT level, covering {period}. The dataset provides HMIS-based indicators across public and private, as well as rural and urban facilities, enabling program monitoring and performance analysis. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (Department of Health and Family Welfare).

Monthly performance indicators for public facilities reporting IPD attendance on the HMIS portal, covering {period}. The scope covers only districts that had shifted to facility-wise data uploading, excluding medical colleges. Data are presented at facility level rollups, capturing active facilities and their reporting and performance status.
